newsitem.title: UK: UK grains under pressure from light farm selling.
newsitem.headline: UK grains under pressure from light farm selling.

text.p: UK cash and grain futures markets came under pressure from light farm selling on Wednesday.
"Farmers appear to be selling some June material, it is not much but it's enough to push prices down," said one broker.
FOB trade was all most at a standstill with values around 0.50 stg a tonne.
"There is talk of business but no one will hold their hand up and say yes I did it," said another broker.
On the delivered market traded levels were one to 1.50 stg down in thin trading.
Old crop LIFFE wheat futures were 0.55 stg down with spillover sentiment pushing new crop 0.15 to 0.25 stg lower on a total turnover of 279 lots.
LIFFE barley futures lost around 0.60 stg with 13 lots on the board.
